svg.title: Detection floor under each processing mode
svg.desc: Three schematic panels, one per intensity processing mode, show the processed signal of a target of the promised reflectance against range. The detection floor is where the curve meets the promised range: under RAW and CORRECTION a longer promised range lowers the floor, under NORMALIZATION the curve is nearly flat and the floor barely moves. The clip at 1 applies to the output only.
svg.text: as detected to a fixed near distance,
then lifted in proportion to range
a surface reads about the same
signal of a target of the promised reflectance
detection floor at the promised range
a longer promised range and the floor it gives
